records.institution: Government of India, Directorate General of Training

modules.title_verbatim: Perform site survey using chain/ tape & prepare a site plan.
Perform the site survey using plane table.
Perform theodolite survey.
Determine of R.L & heights of different points by levelling instruments.
Make topography map using level instrument with contours.
Perform survey work using modern survey instruments (Total station) for prepare a map.
Perform AutoCAD drawing from field survey data.
Plan and prepare setting of GIS & GPS, techniques in various fields.

records.title_verbatim: Certificate III in Surveying and Spatial Information Services
records.entry_as_published: This qualification has no entry requirements.

modules.title_verbatim: Produce basic maps
Collect basic surveying data
Produce basic plans of surveys
Perform simple surveying and spatial computations
Provide field support services for surveying and spatial projects
Operate surveying equipment

verification.method: Qualification description, packaging and all stored core/elective unit codes/titles checked against official training.gov.au PDF pages 2-3.

records.licence_note: © Commonwealth of Australia, 2026; training-package licence terms not assessed.
notes: A national qualification, not a delivered programme; no provider or duration is asserted.
The four surveying-specific core units are mandatory; field support and equipment operation are electives and are labelled as such.
Cadastral work must be supervised by a registered surveyor.
scope_verbatim: This qualification reflects the role of surveying or spatial information services assistants who work under supervision to support a surveying or spatial information services team.
